subject: general
question: Which Indian musician is associated with the Flute?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Hari Prasad Chaurasia**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Hari Prasad Chaurasia** is a renowned Indian **flutist**.
 
• He is known for his expertise in the **Bansuri**, an Indian bamboo flute.
 
• Pandit Chaurasia has significantly contributed to **Hindustani classical music** with his flute performances.
 
• He has received numerous awards, including the **Padma Bhushan and Padma Vibhushan**, for his contributions to Indian music.
 
• Pandit Hari Prasad Chaurasia has also collaborated with various international artists, bringing Indian classical music to a global audience.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ustad Zakir Hussain** is a famous **tabla **player.
 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar** is a legendary **sitar **player.
 
• **Ustad Allahrakha** was a renowned **tabla **player.
 
• The **flute**, or bansuri, is an ancient musical instrument associated with **Hindu deity Lord Krishna**.
 
• Pandit Hari Prasad Chaurasia has trained many students and continues to inspire musicians worldwide.
